messages:
Maria (AE): quick heads-up — Acme Health submitted an orderform that needs special signer routing + split invoicing. MSA/DPA redlines inbound. Can legal + finance confirm signer lanes and which entity gets billed? cc @Raj (SalesOps)

Raj (SalesOps): which entities are we billing? is this a single PO or split across Acme Health Global / Acme UK? any KMS/HSM requirement called out?

Elaine (Legal): please drop the redline copy here when it arrives. also need to know if customer requires DPA with subprocessors enumerated, and whether SLA changes are requested. for signer lanes, we usually need: Legal (MSA) -> GC or delegate; Orderform/PO -> Finance signoff.

contracts-bot: New file uploaded: acme_orderform_v3.pdf (shared to #sales)

Tomas (Finance): if it's split billing we need a mapping table and PO numbers per entity. net60 on POC ok? we should confirm tax jurisdiction for UK invoices.

Maria (AE): customer wants net60 for initial POC only, then net30 after go-live. Two entities: "Acme Health Global, Inc." (US) and "Acme Health UK Ltd." (GB). They said UK invoices must reference VAT reg: GB999888777. No HSM required, but they prefer KMS key rotation notes in the DPA.

Elaine (Legal): got it. i'll review redline when uploaded. action items: 1) ask customer to confirm subprocessors list for DPA 2) supply SOC2 report + brief on KMS config 3) confirm primary signer for each entity and a fallback. propose routing: MSA -> GC (Elaine) ; Orderform -> Finance (Tomas).

Raj (SalesOps): suggested DocuSign routing for signatures:
```
MSA -> Elaine (Legal) -> GC on customer side
Orderform -> Tomas (Finance) -> Customer AP
```
Attach PO to orderform envelope. if split PO, create two envelopes and link to the single MSA.

Tomas (Finance): ack. i'll prepare invoice templates and add fields for VAT and entity code. Maria, please get PO numbers and confirm whether the UK entity needs a separate invoice PDF or consolidated with a ledger line.

Maria (AE): on it. i'll ask customer for PO numbers and subprocessors list and ping when they upload the redline. thanks all :thumbsup:
